home.quote: Our art is space: empty or full, closed or open, real or illusory, dark, illuminated, rational, mad. It is the space of appearance.
home.processSubtitle: Three phases, one continuous flow — every project moves from drawing board to live experience.

project.label: Phase 01
project.title: Project
project.description: We listen, sketch, and shape the brief into precise drawings, technical layouts and 3D studies — the blueprint that anchors every decision.

build.label: Phase 02
build.title: Build
build.description: In our workshop, scenic elements, custom structures and finishes take physical form — engineered to be transported, assembled and lit.

display.label: Phase 03
display.title: Display
display.description: On site, we install, light and dress the space so the experience opens to its audience exactly as designed.
